source: Cambodian MAFF/agricultural extension PowerPoint-derived presentation titled "ដំណាំឪឡឹក" (Watermelon), 42 slides; no presenter, publisher, or date named on the slides reviewed. This presentation exists as two near-identical PDF copies in the source set (one with a green-themed slide design, one plain black-on-white reformat of the same 42 slides) - treat as one source, not two corroborating sources.
text:
Recommended fertilization schedule for watermelon (rates given per hectare unless noted):

Basal application: well-decomposed manure/compost at 7-10 tons per hectare, applied at the bottom of the planting hole/furrow; plus compound fertilizer 15-15-15 at about 200kg, also applied at the bottom.

First top-dressing: about 10 days after planting, apply a foliar/booster fertilizer (urea-type) at about 50kg, dissolved in water and applied as a drench.

Second top-dressing: apply compound 15-15-15 at about 150kg mixed with DAP fertilizer at about 100kg, placed around the plant clump/base, applied about 25 days after planting.

Final top-dressing: apply potash (potassium) fertilizer at about 80kg, applied 45-50 days after planting.
